answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the flag existed because the loser exited 3 and a nonzero transient unit blocks its name (measured 2026-08-18, superclaude lines ~553-559); the loser now exits 0 so the flag has no job. Not assumed: that no other unit the shim starts needs it; ensure_ground_loop is the only systemd-run in the shim's loop start. With the flag in, a loser that regressed to the loud 3 would read as a success.

The ticket carries all of these.
